column1: # Benchmark set drawn from the XCSP3 2022-2025 competition instances; the _cYY/_mcYY suffix is the
# edition (c = main track, mc = mini track). jcsp and Choco 6.0.1 were each run under 3 seeds
# (20260830-20260832) with a 60s budget; times are the median over the seeds that solved it.
# quick: jcsp solves on every seed in under 5s. perf: every seed, 5-60s. gap: jcsp does not solve
# on every seed. Families are kept within one split; tune against measured, confirm on heldout.
# RotatingRostering-044-2-3: xcsp3-tools 2.5 SolutionChecker misjudges its 3-ary eq() and rejects valid solutions.
